host.help:
backdrop — the MixOS desktop background
Usage: backdrop [OPTIONS]
--config PATH      the document to read and that backdrop.set stores
(default: backdrop.mx in the app's config directory)
--colour #RRGGBB   the default: a solid colour, over the document's
--image FILE       the default: a PNG or JPEG, centre-cropped, over the
document's (an absolute path, or relative to here)
--fit MODE         image sizing: fill (default), fit, centre, tile, stretch
--service NAME     register on the Bus as NAME (default backdrop)
--probe            the regression probe: surfaces, scale and input
--help             this text
Bus: backdrop.ping, backdrop.state, backdrop.set, backdrop.next (docs/backdrop/README.md).
--debug[=LEVEL]: off|error|warn|info|debug|trace; --debug means debug. Default: the app baseline (usually warn). RUST_LOG overrides the baseline.
